description: Genuine signal: the reported configuration is the truly best of 20 with real, dispersed Sharpe.
comment: 20 configurations with true annual Sharpe from 0.5 to 3.0; the reported one has a true Sharpe of 3.0 over 5 years. Expected maximum Sharpe by chance with N = 20 and the cross-trial variance is far below it; the in-sample winner stays near the top out of sample, so PBO is low.
